datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators conducted regular (typically monthly) field surveys across Chad to classify acute food insecurity conditions using the IPC framework. Geographic data were collected for different IPC scenarios and compiled into monthly GeoJSON/KML datasets representing spatial distribution of food insecurity phases.
